reasoning: The evidence shows Tesla is actively trying to revive Cybertruck sales with price cuts and new variants as recently as February 2026, not discontinuing it. While sales dropped 48% in 2025 and the RWD variant was discontinued in September 2025, Tesla introduced a new $59,990 AWD model and cut Cyberbeast prices in February 2026. The question asks about full discontinuation of retail sales, not just specific variants. Tesla is clearly still selling Cybertrucks and investing in the product line. With less than a month until April 1, 2026, a complete discontinuation is extremely unlikely.
